attempted_claim: Every 4x4 colored family in R^3 admits, after deletion of any single point, three disjoint rainbow 4-sets with intersecting convex hulls; equivalently the colorful 1-tolerant deleted-join test map for d=3, r=3 with four 4-point colors admits no zero-avoiding equivariant map.
decisive_failure: No proof or disproof of the 4x4 tolerance-1 rainbow claim was obtained. Positive route reduces to the open d=3,r=3 Barany-Larman step; negative route found no blocker in ~380 screened configurations. Screening counts are float-level capped existence checks, not exact certificates.
